# Paperpal

> Paperpal is an AI-powered academic writing and research assistant platform offering comprehensive tools for grammar checking, plagiarism detection, paraphrasing, and manuscript preparation.

Paperpal provides integrated writing solutions across multiple platforms including MS Word, Google Docs, Chrome, and Overleaf, serving researchers, students, and academics. The platform combines AI writing assistance with citation management and content generation capabilities.
